messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D Subway Surfers-style endless runner with three lanes, original gameplay mechanics, and new power-ups.

## Requirements
- Build the game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots at viewport widths no greater than 1280px and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- Created “NEON//RUN — After Hours Express,” a neon-lit, canvas-rendered runner.
- New mechanics include a shard-powered Phase Burst, plus Magnet, Echo Shield, and Time Dilation pickups.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added game UI, responsive styling, canvas-rendered runner, obstacles, shards, three lanes, scoring, keyboard/touch controls, power-ups, pause, and retry flows.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Opened the game in Playwright and saved/read a start-screen JPEG.

### Active
- Visual/gameplay verification remains incomplete; the screenshot was captured, but no follow-up interaction or gameplay screenshot was checked.

### Blocked
- Browser console reported only a missing `/favicon.ico` (404), not a game error.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `/tmp/opencode/neonrun-start.jpg` and exercise start, lane movement, hop, slide, pause, and restart in Playwright.
2. Fix any visual or gameplay defects found and recheck `game.js`.
3. Summarize assumptions and verification results when finishing.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game layout, HUD, screens, and mobile controls.
- `style.css`: Responsive visual design and controls.
- `game.js`: Rendering, gameplay loop, collisions, controls, obstacles, and power-ups.
- `/tmp/opencode/neonrun-start.jpg`: Latest captured start-screen screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local HTTP server was started on port 3002; Playwright opened `http://localhost:3002`.
